opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500‑£750 (Scheme B), up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society junior scientist members (undergraduate, MSc and PhD students, and post‑doctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva) for Scheme A; Scheme B & C open to PhD students and post‑docs within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must be UK‑based members (or non‑UK members attending UK‑based conferences).
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance at Genetics Society meetings, other genetics‑related conferences, and virtual meetings by providing travel, accommodation and registration cost grants.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK, or whose course/training is in the UK. Students need a supervisor’s supporting letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative visits to other laboratories.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members who are studying or working in the UK, or intend to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students need a supervisor’s supporting letter; supervisors must be Society members.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 to cover travel, accommodation, subsistence and essential field equipment for field‑based genetics research projects.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: several hundred to several thousand pounds (typical sponsorship £1,000‑£2,000)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Genetics Society members wishing to sponsor a genetics‑focused meeting not organised directly by the Society. Applications may be submitted at any time.
opportunities.summary: Provides sponsorship for ad‑hoc genetics meetings, covering venue, speaker travel, accommodation and related costs, with a requirement to include a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society. Grants support public engagement activities related to genetics.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,000 to cover travel and material costs for public engagement activities delivered in person or virtually.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members proposing to run a regular series of meetings on a genetics research theme. Applications submitted at least three months before the first meeting.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £2,000 annually to support the organisation of regular meetings for new Special Interest Groups in genetics.
